List triggers#

get/v1/projects/{id}/triggers

List triggers belonging to the project. Required permission: trigger.list.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/triggers" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Create a trigger#

post/v1/projects/{id}/triggers

Create a trigger; referenced pixels must belong to the project. Required permission: trigger.create.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Corpo da requisição

namestringobrigatório
enabledboolean
conditionsobject[]obrigatório
variablestringobrigatório

type: event type (page_view, ad_click, start_checkout, conversion, or a custom event name such as button_click); a trigger without a type condition fires on every event. custom_type: sales platform type (hotmart, kiwify...) on conversion events. network: traffic source of the visit. url and referrer: full URLs. utm_* and sub1-sub8: attribution params.

Valores: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, sub1, sub2, sub3, sub4, sub5, sub6, sub7, sub8, network, url, referrer, type, custom_type

operatorstringobrigatório

Comparisons are case-sensitive. greater_than, less_than, greater_than_or_equals and less_than_or_equals only match when both sides are numbers.

Valores: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, greater_than, less_than, greater_than_or_equals, less_than_or_equals

valuestringobrigatório
actionsobject | object[]obrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/triggers" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "string",
  "enabled": true,
  "conditions": [
    {
      "variable": "utm_source",
      "operator": "equals",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "type": "string",
      "pixelIds": [],
      "event": "string"
    }
  ]
}'
Respostas
201object

Created successfully.
